title: Artichoke-Infused Briny Mediterranean Garlic Bake
description: A rich and savory Mediterranean-inspired brunch dish featuring artichoke hearts, garlic, and feta cheese, all in a velvety briny sauce. Perfect for a weekend morning or a light dinner.
instructions: Prepare the mini puff pastry cocottes by cutting out individual squares, about 1 1/2 inches per side.
In a blender or food processor, combine artichoke hearts, garlic, lemon juice, white wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the blended artichoke mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the heavy cream and parmesan cheese, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce thickens slightly.
Place a spoonful of the sauce into the center of each puff pastry square, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and a pinch of salt.
Fold the pastry squares in half over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the mini cocottes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and brush the tops with egg wash.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, until golden brown and puffed.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley and a drizzle of briny sauce if desired.
Let the individual cocottes cool slightly before serving.
For individual servings, simply multiply the recipe and adjust cooking time as needed.
For an added touch, sprinkle with additional grated parmesan cheese and chopped parsley before serving.
